scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** a scenario identity or normative WHEN/THEN content changes after contract-bound evidence was produced
- **THEN** TDD, validation, review, failure-proof, conformance, and delivery consumers reject the stale digest
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Contract identity is stable and normative::Contract content changes after evidence
scenarios.name: Contract content changes after evidence
scenarios.requirement: Contract identity is stable and normative

scenarios.content:
<!-- failure-invariant: delivery-requires-coherent-receipt-chain concern=persistence -->

- **WHEN** any required receipt is missing, stale, digest-incoherent, or bound to another repository, branch, pull request, or candidate head
- **THEN** delivery fails before an acceptance receipt is produced
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Delivery evidence is repository and candidate bound::Delivery evidence belongs to another candidate or repository
scenarios.name: Delivery evidence belongs to another candidate or repository
scenarios.requirement: Delivery evidence is repository and candidate bound

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** normal material delivery is validated after completed operational directories and raw telemetry are removed
- **THEN** the canonical receipt chain remains executable using at most eight compact episode artifacts
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Durable repository artifacts stay minimal::Historical state is absent
scenarios.name: Historical state is absent

scenarios.content:
<!-- failure-invariant: execution-baseline-drift-is-rejected concern=persistence -->

- **WHEN** execution begins from a dirty, stale, mismatched, default, or differently tracked branch
- **THEN** no execution-baseline receipt is produced
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Execution baseline is immutable Git provenance::Baseline identity drifts
scenarios.name: Baseline identity drifts
scenarios.requirement: Execution baseline is immutable Git provenance

scenarios.content:
<!-- failure-invariant: context-budget-blocks-before-launch concern=subprocess -->

- **WHEN** the complete resolved source set exceeds the declared byte budget
- **THEN** the worker is not launched and the result reports the total, limit, and contributors
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Explicit source byte budgets block before launch::Complete source manifest exceeds budget
scenarios.name: Complete source manifest exceeds budget
scenarios.requirement: Explicit source byte budgets block before launch

scenarios.content:
<!-- failure-invariant: isolated-result-is-complete concern=subprocess -->

- **WHEN** an isolated launch is unavailable, fails, lacks runtime-issued identity or a complete report, or references missing or stale dependency receipts
- **THEN** the result fails closed without manufacturing completion and can be retried from the unchanged manifest
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Isolated execution is optional and receipt based::Isolated result is missing runtime proof or dependencies
scenarios.name: Isolated result is missing runtime proof or dependencies
scenarios.requirement: Isolated execution is optional and receipt based

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** the episode diff and discovered surface differ or a direct episode discovers material impact
- **THEN** route conformance fails before delivery
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Route conformance binds declared and actual episode surfaces::Implementation drifts from declared surface
scenarios.name: Implementation drifts from declared surface
scenarios.requirement: Route conformance binds declared and actual episode surfaces

scenarios.content:
<!-- failure-invariant: routing-readiness-cannot-be-bypassed concern=state-machine -->

- **WHEN** a direct assessment contains a true or unknown material signal, or a material assessment has an unresolved decision, missing synthesis, or missing authorization
- **THEN** the harness refuses the next receipt and identifies the unsatisfied gate
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Routing and requirements fail closed::Direct or gated work attempts to bypass readiness
scenarios.name: Direct or gated work attempts to bypass readiness

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** an axis is missing, both axes share an identity, an outcome is incomplete, or either axis reviews another candidate or contract
- **THEN** no passing review receipt is produced
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Standards and Spec review remain independent::Review identity, axis, or candidate is incomplete
scenarios.name: Review identity, axis, or candidate is incomplete
scenarios.requirement: Standards and Spec review remain independent

scenarios.content:
<!-- failure-invariant: failure-proof-covers-current-contract concern=state-machine -->

- **WHEN** a marked invariant is absent, a proof refers to another contract or head, or correct and known-bad behavior receive the same result
- **THEN** review completion and delivery are rejected
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Stateful failure proof discriminates good and known-bad behavior::Failure proof is incomplete or non-discriminating
scenarios.name: Failure proof is incomplete or non-discriminating
scenarios.requirement: Stateful failure proof discriminates good and known-bad behavior

scenarios.content:
<!-- failure-invariant: tdd-requires-discriminating-red-green concern=subprocess -->

- **WHEN** RED passes, GREEN fails, a known-bad implementation passes, the oracle changes, or either phase is bound to another contract or candidate
- **THEN** the harness refuses the TDD receipt
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::TDD receipt binds RED and GREEN symmetrically::Weak, tuned, stale, or known-bad implementation
scenarios.name: Weak, tuned, stale, or known-bad implementation
scenarios.requirement: TDD receipt binds RED and GREEN symmetrically

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** an isolated result does not contain a runtime-issued metric
- **THEN** the compact summary reports that metric as unavailable and labels any repository-controlled observations separately
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Telemetry is compact and honest::Runtime metrics are absent
scenarios.name: Runtime metrics are absent

scenarios.content:
- **WHEN** any meaning-changing input or candidate head differs from a prior successful receipt
- **THEN** reuse is rejected and a new validation result is required
scenarios.id: harness/receipt-workflow::Validation reuse binds the meaning-changing closure::Validation input closure drifts
scenarios.name: Validation input closure drifts
scenarios.requirement: Validation reuse binds the meaning-changing closure
